note: What NPCs sound like (M15). Rifles, footsteps and hurt are the Kenney FPS starter kit (CC0, already in assets/third_party); the radio chatter under barks and the town alarm klaxon are synthesized by tools/audio/make_npc_sfx.py. Distances in metres, volumes in dB.

comms.note: Speeder racers talk over the comms once you accept a race (src/systems/voice/npc_voice.gd _play_comms): heard flat, as loud wherever the racer is, on its own bus (made at start if the layout has none, sending to send): cut below high_pass_hz, overdriven (drive 0..1, pre_gain_db, post_gain_db), cut above low_pass_hz. Static under the voice (hiss_s loop, crackle pops a second, made in code at mix_rate) and a squelch click_s long at each end (dying away at click_decay a second). Volumes in dB.
